system.description:
• Effect: You begin play with one item already made — chosen freely from your Kit's Known list in The Artificer's Workshop — with no Ingenuity Point cost and no crafting time spent.
  • An Infuser starts with one item already infused (the infusion lasts as normal and can be renewed the usual way once it ends); a Gadgeteer starts with one gadget already built and ready to use; an Alchemist starts with one formula already brewed and in their pack.
  • A Construct Engineer instead starts with one Modular Chassis mount already installed on their companion at no cost, on top of the companion itself.
